scene_purpose: Open Chapter 4 the morning after the player deliberately begins it, establish a large territorial animal disturbance caused in part by Cresthaven reoccupation, let the party inspect evidence without a recap briefing, and hand directly into following the Elder Thornhide trail.

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Exact player position, optional cleanup history, current HP/MP, fatigue, weather, and other live gameplay state must come from the runtime merge if relevant. Do not invent them from repository authority.

current_floor_state.prime_card_knowledge: The party knows Prime Card is a recurring Ancient Diysean term distinct in context from ordinary Standard Cards. No one may transfer author-only Last Sentinel Recovered/Prime-system mechanics into character knowledge.
